snippet.title: Remnants of the Rift - 1.0 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656050/Remnants_of_the_Rift/

What if closure was at the end of another dimension? Prepare to dive into retro-futuristic action roguelite Remnants of the Rift to search for the answer! 

Dive into a world between worlds as the game is coming out of Early Access for Steam on May 29th and launching on Nintendo Switch 1 as well.

Discord: https://discord.gg/pEaZ3RUt84 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/BromioDev 
Website: http://remnantsoftherift.com/
